mapper.select: SELECT ao.id, ao.adjustment_no, ao.adjustment_type, ao.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, ao.erp_tenant_id, t.tenant_name AS owner_name, ao.adjustment_date, ao.order_status, ao.adjustment_reason, ao.reject_reason, ao.confirm_time, ao.create_time FROM wms_adjustment_order ao LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON ao.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = ao.erp_tenant_id WHERE ao.id = #{id} AND ao.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_adjustment_order WHERE adjustment_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND deleted = 0
